stem.text: Let \( f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{x^{2} - 25}{x - 5}, & x < 5 \\ kx + m, & 5 \le x \le 6 \\ - 2 x^{2} - 4, & x > 6 \end{cases} \), where k and m are constants. Find the values of k and m for which f is continuous for all real numbers.

answer_key.label: \( k = -86 \) and \( m = 440 \), because the middle branch must equal 10 at \( x = 5 \) and -76 at \( x = 6 \).

worked_solution.text: For \( x < 5 \), \( \frac{x^{2} - 25}{x - 5} = x + 5 \), so the limit from the left at \( x = 5 \) is 10. The middle branch gives \( f(5) = 5k + m \), so \( 5k + m = 10 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: match the branches at the first boundary

worked_solution.text: At \( x = 6 \) the middle branch gives \( f(6) = 6k + m \) and the last branch approaches -76, so \( 6k + m = -76 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: match the branches at the second boundary

worked_solution.text: Subtracting the equations gives \( k = -86 \), and then \( m = 440 \).

options.derivation: at x = 6 the first branch, which applies only for x < 5, used in place of the last branch
